reason: I already carry a LARQ every day and it does the job. Nothing here tells me why Claro beats it, and $68 up front plus a filter subscription just to replace something that works isn't happening.
objection: I already have a bottle that works. On top of that I don't know this brand, and I'd be signing up for filters forever on a bottle I don't need.
would_change_my_mind: Proof from an independent lab that it actually takes out more than my current bottle, like the chlorine and off taste in hotel tap water, plus a bottle-only price under $35 with shipping included and no subscription.
